paragraphs.source_en: One device consists in restricting the membership of the union on some other basis than that of proved competence or skill. This restriction may take many forms: it may consist in charging new workers excessive initiation fees;in arbitrary membership qualifications; in discrimination, .open or concealed, on grounds of religion, race or sex; -in some absolute limitation on the number of members,or in exclusion, by force if necessary, not only of the products of non-union labor, but of the products even of affiliated unions in other states or cities.

paragraphs.source_en: The most obvious case in which intimidation and force are used to put or keep the wages of a particular union above the real market worth of its members’ services is that of a strike. A peaceful strike is possible. To the ex-tent that it remains peaceful, it is a legitimate labor weapon, even though it is one that should be used rarely and as a Jast resort. If his workers as a body withhold their labor, they may bring a stubborn employer, who has been underpaying them, to his senses, He may find that he is unable to replace these workers by workers equally:good who are willing to accept the wage that the former have now rejected.
